title: Realtime lights: default off, ambient ramp, time of day, walls block, reach cache, roof dim, target teardown

steps.say: Check the tile-grid light field without game data (ADR-0039).

do.text: Default-off persistence, day/dusk/night ambient, the UO+ time-of-day clock, light cycle and tints (default off, shard clock), torches weaker by day, light-target canvas items freed on teardown, the tiledata blocking rule, a wall blocking and a gap passing light, falloff to zero at the radius, cache hit and invalidation, roof dim by day only. A lit room by night and the classic frame with the option off are rendered evidence runs.
